name: Station battery continuity supervision
aliases: substations Station battery and charger distribution
summary: Identifies the selected method for monitoring the continuity of the assigned battery connection.
description: Identifies the selected method for monitoring the continuity of the assigned battery connection. A station battery system supplies protection, control and other assigned DC loads through a documented charger and distribution arrangement. Charger output, battery contribution and load distribution are related but separately monitored paths.

In a substation control building, the battery can support breaker trip circuits while the charger AC supply is unavailable. Supervision must identify whether the charger, battery or a downstream feeder is affected. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Battery connection supervision” at the input and “Battery-path health indication” at the output. The monitoring method must be documented.

Identify every source, protective device, isolation boundary and return. Battery capacity, DC fault duty, charging settings and ventilation require the selected battery-system design; illustrative circuits do not establish autonomy. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
